turns.assistant: fanOut() is @Transactional and calls the Slack webhook inside the transaction, so each request holds a connection for the HTTP round trip. 200 Tomcat threads against a pool of 10 starves. Move the notification outside the transaction; do not just raise the pool, Postgres has max_connections=100 shared with other services.
After moving the webhook call out of the transaction p99 went from 28 s to 640 ms under the k6 peak profile.
